skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental concepts of linguistics, including the nature, origin, and development of language, phonetics, vocabulary, and grammar.
Apply theoretical knowledge to explain specific linguistic phenomena and compare different linguistic theories.
Confidently express and explain linguistic concepts and theories.
Independently and creatively conduct research, prepare lectures, and presentations on linguistic topics.
Proactively engage in language-related projects and take responsibility for applying linguistic theories to solve practical problems.
Work effectively in groups, share responsibilities, and contribute to group presentations and discussions.
Prepare and deliver presentations on linguistic topics, managing time and engaging the audience effectively.
Analyze linguistic data and theories, identify unique characteristics, and apply theoretical knowledge creatively.
Identify and solve linguistic problems using theoretical knowledge and practical application.
